```{r}
# logisticf firth regression 
modelsummary(list(logistf(EC ~ adjCases + roughIFR + spreadWest + CRatchet, ECorNO), 
                   logistf(EC ~ roughIFR + spreadWest + CRatchet, ECorNO),
                   logistf(EC ~ roughIFR + CRatchet, ECorNO),
                   logistf(EC ~ CRatchet, ECorNO)),
             stars = getOption("modelsummary_stars", default = TRUE))
```

The preview shows you a rendered HTML copy of the contents of the editor. Consequently, unlike *Knit*, *Preview* does not run any R code chunks. Instead, the output of the chunk when it was last run in the editor is displayed.

```{r}
#making a graph of the differing speed of possible pheics to ECs, split by DGs

ECSpeed |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date_firstEC, y = DaystoEC, color = DG)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Event), size = 4, vjust = -1, show.legend = F) +
  geom_text(aes(label = DaystoEC), size = 4, vjust = 2, show.legend = F) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 4",
    subtitle = "DG responsiveness by # days from outset before each outbreak received its first IHR EC meeting",
    x = "Days from outset of outbreak to first EC meeting",
    y = "Date of first EC meeting",
    caption = "Each outbreak labeled by shortened name above and # of days from outset to first EC meeting below each point."
  ) +
  theme_linedraw()
```

```{r}
#making a graph of the differing speed of possible pheics to ECs for each DG

ECSpeed_Chan |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date_firstEC, y = DaystoEC), color = "red") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Event), size = 2, vjust = -1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = DaystoEC), size = 2, vjust = 2)

ECSpeed_Gheb |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date_firstEC, y = DaystoEC), color = "lightblue") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Event), size = 2, vjust = -1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = DaystoEC), size = 2, vjust = 2)
```

```{r}
#chart illustrating strange distribution of ECs among epidemiological data

ECorNO |> filter(adjCases < 9000) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = adjCases, y = roughIFR, color = ECyn)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1",
    subtitle = "Morbidity vs. spread of outbreaks at time of first EC or comparable point",
    x = "Cases per day from outbreak outset to EC (or comparable)",
    y = "Infection Fatality Rate (deaths / cases)",
    color = "EC"
  )
```

```{r}
#chart illustrating distribution of timing in responsiveness

ECSpeed |>
  ggplot(aes(x = adjCases, y = DaystoEC, color = PHEIC)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2",
    subtitle = "DG Responsiveness vs. Spread: Days to EC vs Cases per day",
    x = "Cases per day from outbreak outset to EC",
    y = "Days to EC"
  )

ECSpeed |>
  ggplot(aes(x = roughIFR, y = DaystoEC, color = PHEIC)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2",
    subtitle = "DG Responsiveness vs. Morbidity: Days to EC vs Infection Fatality Rate (IFR)",
    x = "IFR (total suspected deaths / suspected cases)",
    y = "Days to EC"
  )
```
```{r}
#chart illustrating strange distribution of ECs among epidemiological data

ECSpeed |>
  ggplot(aes(x = adjCases, y = DaystoEC, color = roughIFR)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2",
    subtitle = "DG Responsiveness vs. Epidemiological Data: Days to EC vs Cases per day, colored by IFR*",
    x = "Cases per day from outbreak outset to EC",
    y = "Days to EC",
    color = "IFR",
    caption = "\n*Infection Fatality Rate, total suspected deaths divided by total suspected cases"
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "black", high = "red")
```
